notes.title: Girl of the Month Voting (July)
notes.content: [h3]Hi everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]Right now, there's a new poll live on my Patreon page — we're voting for the Girl of the Month! The winner will be featured in brand-new 4K wallpapers, both SFW and NSFW.[/p][p]This month, the winning theme is [i]Students[/i].[/p][p]Now it’s time to choose the girl herself![/p][p]Head over and vote for your favorite![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/Woundead"]https://www.patreon.com/Woundead[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Meet last month’s winner: [b]Jessica[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881308/6b931efebf27c982c2927db015a471a15768c27c.png"][/img][/p][p]A few words about Act 3 development.[/p][p]The process is moving along steadily, sometimes picking up speed, sometimes slowing down. Not long ago, there was an incident with CPU overheating — during rendering, the temperature would rise to 99–100°C, causing a blue screen crash. I won’t go into too much detail, but the issue has been partially resolved for now, and I’m continuing my work. I’ve written more about this situation on [url="https://www.patreon.com/Woundead"]Patreon[/url].[/p][p]Lately, I’ve been trying to dedicate more time to development and even occasionally take days off from my day job to focus on the project. I know everyone’s curious about the release dates — no one likes to wait. I feel the same way, which is why I’m pushing myself as much as I can.[/p][p]If you want to stay up to date and get the latest news first, consider following me on social media and support platforms. It really helps the game’s development.[/p][p]There are also some nice bonuses there, like NSFW artwork.[/p][p][url="https://www.patreon.com/Woundead" style="button" buttoncolor="#552277"]Woundead[/url][/p]

notes.title: Latest Development News
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

It's been a while since my last Steam update, and as always, the reason is my busy schedule. I’m still working alone and have to balance game development with my main job, which takes up a lot of valuable time.

However, the project is moving forward! Right now, I’m actively working on Act 3.

[b]About Act 3[/b]
This will be the most ambitious act so far:

[list]
[*] Free movement with major events,
[*] Character relationship development,
[*] Deeper character backstories and lore.
[/list]
Act 3 will introduce a lot of new content but also raise even more questions. The workload is huge, but the final result will be worth it!

[b]What’s New?[/b]
✅ Improved character body physics – characters look even more realistic in intimate scenes.
✅ Experimenting with simulations – Daz3D is quite "stiff" by default, but I’ve managed to achieve some interesting results. You’ll see this in new animations.
✅ Higher-quality visuals – my skills keep improving, and it’s noticeable in the latest scenes.
✅ New post-processing techniques – visuals now look even more polished and appealing.

[b]Current Work[/b]
Right now, I’m focused on:

[list]
[*] Writing scenes and dialogues,
[*] Rendering artwork and animations,
[*] Creating and refining locations,
[*] Writing game code.
[/list]
Some scenes in Act 3 feature over 20 characters at once. These aren’t just background NPCs – they are full-fledged characters that require individual work. This takes time, but I’m confident the result will be worth it.

[b]The Future of the Project[/b]
Looking back at Acts 1 and 2, I see many areas for improvement. Act 3 needs to be a step above. The only limiting factor is time. As I’ve said before, quality is my top priority, and I will take as much time as necessary to deliver it.

After releasing Act 2, I also focused on promoting the project. I handle everything myself, but I’ve already seen some progress – my social media pages are starting to grow. Hopefully, in the future, this will allow me to fully dedicate myself to game development and leave my day job.

I apologize if I haven’t been able to respond to everyone – my workload is intense. The best way to reach me is via Discord.

If you want exclusive updates and bonuses, follow me on social media and other platforms. I post news every week!

And now – a few shots of the Girls of the Month. Remember, voting takes place on my Patreon, so you can cast your vote for your favorite!

Thank you for your support! ❤️ Thanks to you, this project continues to grow and evolve!

Woundead

notes.title: Act 2 release!
notes.content:
Here it is, the long awaited release!
[h2]
Act 2: Dead End is available now![/h2] All you need to do is update your game!

Congratulations to everyone on this event!

Honestly, I'm incredibly excited. I've put a lot of hard work and time into this Act. I hope it doesn't disappoint you. 

I will duplicate again the content of Act 2:

2,423 renders (not counting renders for eventing during free movement)
71 animations
35 new music tracks (including a few of my own)
36 new sound effects
Significantly improved image quality compared to Act 1.

Let me also remind you about the translation. I would like to ask you to give feedback on its quality. On this will depend on further cooperation with this translator.

It's been months of hard work, at times very exhausting due to my main job. Unfortunately, I don't yet have the financial ability to completely quit my job to focus solely on game development. But hopefully that opportunity will come soon.

I would like to thank everyone who has played my game.

I thank everyone who supports my hard work.

I am immensely grateful to the patrons who have supported, are supporting, or will continue to support me and my projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881308/9c24c563f230149ad1ca5824636f3183b2fda9ab.png[/img]

Due to my constant busyness, it is difficult for me to respond to all the messages that come in. I feel terribly bad about leaving someone out, but I can't do it any other way. I apologize for this.

Thanks again to each and every one of you!

I wish you an enjoyable game!

Woundead

P.S. Subscribe to my social media to stay up to date with news!

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/Woundead

Boosty: https://boosty.to/woundead7
